meaningKo: 어려운 상황을 견디다, 불리한 상황에 맞서다
exampleEn: Sometimes you just have to bite the bullet and make that difficult phone call.
exampleKo: 가끔은 그냥 참고 그 어려운 전화 통화를 해야 할 때가 있어.
gameExamples: In order to finish the project on time, I had to bite the bullet and work late into the night.
When the team faced criticism, they decided to bite the bullet and improve their performance.
She knew it would be tough, but she had to bite the bullet and confront her fears.
